Pets Are dogs allowed throughout Hewing Hotel?
Dogs are welcome at Hewing Hotel, though they are not permitted on the Rooftop, in the fitness center, or inside Tullibee.
Guests can still enjoy dog-friendly rooms, thoughtful in-room amenities, and nearby North Loop spots for walking, dining, and exploring.
Is Hewing Hotel close to dog parks or green spaces?
Yes, Hewing Hotel is close to dog-friendly outdoor spaces in the North Loop .
North Loop Green offers a free public off-leash dog run open daily from 7 AM to 10 PM, and dogs are welcome on The Green when leashed.
Are there dog-friendly restaurants nearby in Minneapolis?
Yes, the North Loop is home to several dog-friendly patios, restaurants, cafés, and local spots within easy reach of Hewing Hotel.
